items.title: Lock unattended product outcome and authority decision
items.context: Before implementation, record the product end-state and a decision/preMortem for unattended execution: user opt-in, secret/env filtering, host login/network limits, receipt trust model, worker lease/conflict handling, no auto-merge, no auto-DONE, no productionDone, and relationship to B-106b Host Overflow.
items.userSees: lattice decision_get --storyId=B-a5c2 --json shows the chosen policy-authorized unattended mode, explicit no-authority boundaries, and preMortem risks.

happy.desc: decision_set records the chosen user-authorized unattended scheduler model and user-visible completion flow.

edge.desc: preMortem covers missing policy, unsafe host capability, secret/env leakage, stuck workers, mixed outcomes, and stale receipts.

adversarial.desc: decision explicitly forbids auto-merge, auto-DONE, authorityChanged=true, receiptVerified=true, and productionDone=true from unattended host output.

items.title: Verify Claude Code CLI bounded unattended feasibility early
items.context: Before building abstractions, verify the concrete host assumption: Claude Code CLI is present, versioned, can run a bounded noninteractive/dry-run or minimal safe command in an isolated cwd, can produce transcript/exit metadata, and any missing guarantee is surfaced as unavailable or supervised-only.
items.userSees: lattice host_runtime_probe --host=claude-code --json reports whether Claude Code is unattended-capable, supervised-only, or unavailable, with nextAction.

happy.desc: A minimal Claude Code CLI probe/smoke records version, command path, cwd support, transcript support, and noninteractive feasibility.

edge.desc: If any required guarantee is missing, the result degrades to supervised-only or unavailable with visible nextAction.

adversarial.desc: Claude Code availability alone never authorizes unattendedSafe=true without policy, cwd, timeout, transcript, and bounded command guarantees.

items.title: Implement dispatch_policy contract and CLI surfaces
items.context: Add policy schema and commands for creating, inspecting, and checking unattended authorization: allowedHosts, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, maxParallel, maxRuntimeMinutes, budget, network, environment allow/deny, command allowlist, retry limits, and receipt/review requirements.
items.userSees: lattice dispatch_policy check --policy=<name> reports authorized/denied, exact reasons, and whether the run must fall back to supervised/manual mode.

happy.desc: Policy check accepts a bounded policy with allowed hosts, paths, parallelism, timeout, and receipt/review gates.

edge.desc: Policy check degrades to supervised/manual when optional budget or host capability data is unavailable.

adversarial.desc: Policy check rejects missing policy, absolute/traversal paths, denied-path overlap, unlimited parallelism, unsafe env, and attempts to enable auto-merge or productionDone.

items.title: Implement real host unattended capability contract
items.context: Extend host runtime probes for Claude Code, Gemini, and Codex with structured unattended capability fields: version/login readiness, noninteractive mode, cwd support, timeout behavior, transcript mode, environment safety, receipt support, and unattendedSafe reasons. This milestone only reports capability; it does not launch hosts.
items.userSees: lattice host_runtime_list --json shows fake/claude-code/gemini/codex with unattended capability, degradations, and nextAction.

happy.desc: Claude Code, Gemini, and Codex probes expose structured unattended capability fields without starting a worker.

edge.desc: Unavailable or partially supported CLI reports visible degradation and actionable nextAction without blocking fake coverage.

adversarial.desc: A detected CLI never becomes unattendedSafe unless required noninteractive, cwd, timeout, transcript, env, and policy guarantees are present.

items.title: Expose runner status through user-facing commands
items.context: Build the bounded runner artifact and surface it through user-facing status/review output: command template, cwd, startedAt/endedAt, exitCode or timeout, transcript path, and sanitized environment summary must be visible through dispatch_watch or dispatch_status so the user can decide whether to retry, inspect, or stop. This milestone only handles raw runner status, not receipt trust.
items.userSees: lattice dispatch_watch --dispatchId=<id> or dispatch_status shows runner command, cwd, exit/timeout, transcript path, and retry/inspect/stop nextAction.

happy.desc: Runner captures transcript/exit status and dispatch_watch or dispatch_status renders those details with a user nextAction.

edge.desc: Timeout or nonzero exit persists diagnostic runner status and tells the user whether to inspect transcript, retry, or stop.

adversarial.desc: Runner refuses non-template commands, forbidden env leaks, invalid cwd, unsafe output paths, and commands not authorized by policy; user-facing status shows refusal reason.

items.title: Implement dispatch_auto scheduler and dispatch_watch
items.context: Add scheduler commands that read dispatch_policy, choose only allowed unattended-safe hosts, create isolated worktrees, start bounded runner jobs, enforce maxParallel/retry/time limits, persist worker states, and provide watch/status output. Receipt and merge authority stay outside this milestone.
items.userSees: lattice dispatch_auto --storyId=B-xxxx --policy=<name> starts or refuses workers with reasons; lattice dispatch_watch shows planned/running/diagnostic/needs_receipt statuses.

happy.desc: dispatch_auto starts authorized fake/host-dry-run workers and dispatch_watch reports prepared/running/needs_receipt/diagnostic states.

edge.desc: Scheduler handles one worker failure while preserving successful worker evidence and bounded retry metadata.

adversarial.desc: Scheduler refuses to start when policy is missing, host not allowed, maxParallel exceeded, scope unsafe, or host capability is not unattended-safe.

items.title: Collect unattended evidence and preserve manual review/merge gates
items.context: Collect transcript, git changed files, required command output, runner metadata, and local diagnostic receipts for unattended workers; integrate dispatch_review and dispatch_merge_plan so outputs are evidence candidates only and merge/DONE remain manual gate-controlled.
items.userSees: dispatch_review shows unattended transcripts/diffs/receipts; dispatch_merge_plan remains manualOnly and says host completion is not production authority.

happy.desc: Collector records transcript, changedFiles, command outputs, runner metadata, and local diagnostic receipt for a completed unattended worker.
Review and merge commands surface unattended evidence with manual next actions.

edge.desc: Missing transcript, missing receipt, stale diff, or partial worker outcomes yield diagnostic status and nextAction without erasing successful evidence.

adversarial.desc: Forged host text or unattended receipts cannot bypass review passes, validation evidence, delivery check, server receipt requirements, or set receiptVerified/authorityChanged/productionDone true.

items.title: Validate full user-facing unattended Claude Code flow
items.context: Add final E2E/product validation for a real story-style unattended flow: user creates/checks a policy, probes Claude Code, starts dispatch_auto with a safe bounded real Claude Code smoke when policy and capability allow or receives an explicit policy/capability refusal, watches worker start/refuse/succeed/fail states, reviews transcript/diff/receipt evidence, and receives a manual nextAction/merge plan. Fake parallel E2E and docs remain required, but final acceptance must prove the user-visible closeout.
items.userSees: Docs and smoke transcript show: dispatch_policy check, host_runtime_probe, dispatch_auto, dispatch_watch, dispatch_review, and manual dispatch_merge_plan for a bounded Claude Code-capable flow.

happy.desc: E2E smoke passes for fake parallel unattended flow and a safe bounded Claude Code opt-in flow when capability/policy allow it, with watch/review/merge nextActions visible.

edge.desc: If Claude Code capability or policy is insufficient, the smoke records an explicit supervised/manual refusal with nextAction instead of pretending the run happened.
Tests cover missing policy, unavailable host, timeout, missing receipt, and mixed worker outcomes.

adversarial.desc: Tests cover path traversal, symlink output escape, denied path overlap, host overclaim, accidental auto-merge, and productionDone regressions.
Docs show the opt-in command sequence and state unattended mode remains user-authorized and authority-safe.
